title: Integrate text-generating AI with another software, train AI and build a WordPress site.
description: Hey everyone! I need someone who knows about text-generating AI (preferably OpenAI) and the process of integrating this AI with another software (Docmosis) to accomplish the final result. Also needs to have good web designing skills and make it look clean and professional. Need someone with good communication skills so I can explain what I want to change or include. If the freelancer/agency speaks Spanish, that's a plus. I'm looking forward to working with the amazing talent here! My project consists in automating the process of creating service notes for Case Managers. Case Managers are professionals responsible for providing assistance to low-income people suffering from mental disorders. To automate the process of creating service notes, I plan to use two tools: Docmosis and OpenAI. Docmosis will allow the Case Managers to connect their customer database with OpenAI's artificial intelligence to generate customized text based on each customer's data. As for implementation, I need to create a website dedicated to my market niche where I will integrate these functions, allowing Case Managers to generate notes in an automated way, saving time and effort in writing them. In summary, my project aims to ease the work of Case Managers by automating the process of creating service notes, using tools such as Docmosis and OpenAI, and presenting the information in a structured way, through a website dedicated to this purpose. The website could have the following sections: Homepage: this page would present a brief summary of what the website offers and a button to log in. Login page: users could log in to the platform using their username and password. User profile page: once logged in, users could view their profile, where their personal details and a history of the service notes they have generated would be displayed. Client selection page: users can select the clients for whom they want to generate a service note. Service notes generation page: once the client is selected, users can generate a service note using OpenAI's artificial intelligence. This page could have a form for users to enter relevant information about the intervention and a button to activate the automatic generation of the service note. Help page: this page would have articles on how to use the website Contact Us page: this page would have a form where users can contact the website administrator Additionally, the website would have a feature that allows users to export the service notes in both word and PDF formats.

title: Two Hours of Training on openHAB and Using Webhooks from WordPress to Control Alexa Devices
description: We are looking for an openHAB expert to prepare and deliver two hours of training on how to integrate an external website (on WordPress) to openHAB using webhooks or API in order to pass text commands to Alexa devices and check for status (e.g., on, off, etc.) of devices. The goal is to train a small number of business users (with entry-level programming skills in JavaScript and PHP) on how they can utilize webhooks and/or API calls to openHAB to control smart devices attached to Amazon's Alexa and to update the WordPress website with the status of devices. NO WordPress training is needed; participants will already know how to send and receive webhooks or API calls from/ to WordPress. By the conclusion of the training, attendees will have: 1) Learned the basics of openHAB, its models and components (bindings, things, channels, items, rules, and scripts) 2) Learned how to trigger Alexa TextCommands by sending a webhook or API request to openHAB from a WordPress site 3) Learned how to return to the WordPress site status information for Alexa-connected devices from openHAB 4) Sent their first TextCommand request to Alexa 5) Polled (send inquiry to) openHAB for status information of one Alexa-connected device The course can be divided into two 1-hr sessions if desired, or delivered as a single 2-hr session. The training must be delivered live, in English, via teleconference (Zoom, Google Meet, etc.). Participants will attend from the Eastern time zone of the US. The sessions should be instructor led with Q&A all throughout. Prior reading or videos (e.g., YouTube tutorials, sections from the openHAB documentation, etc.) can be assigned for participants to review prior to the training. The live sessions will be recorded ONLY by us the client, will be owned by us the client, and may not be shared with any outside parties as the business content is CONFIDENTIAL. The courses should cover the following content: Session 1 - openHAB basics: - Introduction to openHAB Bindings, Things, Channels, Items & Models - Review of popular Bindings - Explanation of Models - How to create Things, Items, and Channels - How to create Pages to control devices - How to create Rules - How to create Scripts - How to Create Schedules - Introduction to openHAB Cloud and the functionality it provides vs the local openHAB server application - Any other introductory content deemed beneficial by instructor Session 2 – HANDS ON SESSION: Using Webhooks or API to send commands to Alexa devices via openHAB request (Participants will screen share and write their first requests along with the instructor) - How to receive a webhook or API request in openHAB Cloud to trigger an action, rule, or script, to include the syntax and payload - How to create the trigger that will listen for the webhook or API call and start an action - How to send the TextCommand to Alexa and confirm successful receipt - How to communicate success or failure of the request back to the WordPress site via webhook - How to poll openHAB to send state (e.g., on, off, etc.) information from devices back to WordPress website via webhook - Any other content deemed beneficial by instructor The content above may be modified by the openHAB instructor for time and impact in consultation with us. What we are trying to accomplish: After the training, participants should be able to control Alexa devices from a WordPress site. For example, a cron job on the WordPress site may trigger a request to openHAB to send a command to an Amazon thermostat in order to turn off the lights at a location when a guest checks out of the property. As another example, a cron job may send a request to openHAB to send a command to Alexa to turn on the HVAC at a property an hour before a guest is scheduled to arrive. Lastly, an admin dashboard on the WordPress site may give users the ability to see the status of lights and other devices at the property and control them from the WordPress site. openHAB experts are invited to apply

description: App Design: The app design should be simple, user-friendly, and visually appealing. The color scheme should be modern and vibrant, with high-quality images of food and restaurants to capture the attention of users. Here are some design elements that should be incorporated into the app: • Navigation Bar: A navigation bar at the bottom of the screen that allows users to easily access the app's key features, such as search, filters, and account settings. • Search Bar: A search bar at the top of the screen that allows users to quickly find restaurants, dishes, or cuisines that they are interested in. • Restaurant Listings: A grid view of local restaurants that have excess food inventory, showing their logo, name, location, and rating. Users should be able to click on a restaurant to view more information, such as the menu, reviews, and operating hours. • Meal Selection: An intuitive menu selection process that allows users to easily select the meals they want to order. The user should be able to see a photo, name, description, and price for each meal. • Checkout: A simple checkout process that allows users to pay for their meal using a credit card or other payment method. Users should be able to see a breakdown of their total cost, including any discounts or promotions. • Notifications: Push notifications should be sent to users when they make an order or when a new restaurant is added to the app. UX/UI: The app should have a user-friendly and intuitive UX/UI design. Here are some key elements to consider: • Onboarding: A simple onboarding process that allows users to easily create an account and start using the app. • Menu Navigation: The app should have a simple and intuitive menu navigation that allows users to easily find the information they are looking for. • Filters: A set of filters that allow users to easily search for restaurants and meals based on their preferences, such as location, cuisine, and price. • Personalization: The app should use machine learning algorithms to provide personalized meal recommendations and offers based on the user's preferences and past orders. • Ratings and Reviews: Users should be able to leave ratings and reviews for restaurants and meals, providing feedback to other users and helping them make informed decisions. • Notifications: Push notifications should be used to keep users informed of their order status, new promotions, and other important updates. • Profile: Users should have access to a profile where they can manage their payment information, view their order history, and update their account settings. Overall, the app design should be intuitive, visually appealing, and user-friendly, with a focus on providing a seamless and enjoyable experience for users.

Ako predohru k filmovým projekciám plánujeme vytvoriť informačnú prednášku, ktorá pomôže "naservírovať" film divákovi a poskytne potrebné súvislosti o výrobe filmu, informácie o živote producenta, kontexte vzniku filmu, ako aj o tom, prečo film vyniká.(Planujeme 6 premietani do konca aprila takze 6 prac takeho typu)Toto zadanie je pre film: FRAGILE MEMORY // КРИХКА ПАМ'ЯТЬNa realizáciu projektu by bolo dobré mať nasledujúce zručnosti:- Základné znalosti o filme (Text by nemal byť akademickou analýzou, ale ani príliš základnou, mal by byť pútavý pre diváka s mierne nadpriemernou úrovňou filmových skúseností. Nie článok z wikipédie - mal by sprostredkovať všetky potrebné zaujímavé informácie tak, aby nevyznievali nútene)- Písanie poloformálnym štýlom ( Diváci sú väčšinou mladí a prichádzajú za zážitkom do spoločnosti, dôležitá je dobrá znalosť tónu a pridanie humoru a pridanie "prízemných" opisov zložitejších tém.- Dobré rešeršné zručnosti (Niektoré filmy sú nezávislou zahraničnou produkciou a môžu si vyžadovať viac prezerania (a možno aj prekladu a overovania faktov) ako zvyčajne, aby ste sa dostali ku všetkým informáciám.- Znalosť angličtiny a slovenčiny (ideálne aj ukrajinčiny alebo ruštiny) Keďže naše filmy sú vo väčšine prípadov zahraničné (neslovenské a neanglické), ďalšia znalosť iných jazykov by bola veľmi užitočná.Potrebujeme mať úvod, nie veľmi formálny, urobiť z toho trošku narrativny rozhovor o filme.Plánujeme robiť viacero takých premietaní a potrebujeme tento text ku každej. Čo sa týka dostupnosti filmu, vieme vám zabezpečiť jeho pozretie prostredníctvom stránky dafilms.com Tam sa dá za 2,50 pozrieť tieto filmy, viem to prirátať k cene alebo ponúknuť pozriete cez naše konto.Materiály ku filmu čiže články atď priamo k dispozícii nemáme, je to súčasť tasku urobiť rešerš o filme a režisére.O nás:Naše združenie sa snaží prostredníctvom filmov ukázať kultúru vybranej krajiny - cez oči ľudí odtiaľ. Je to hlavná pointa celého projektu. Aby ľudia si pochopili čo to pre tých ľudí znamená byť X kultúrou, a na akých problémoch im záleží alebo na aké dávajú dôraz.Zohľadniť tento cieľ projektu v rámci textu by bolo vhodné.Naše združenie sa venuje rôznorodým kultúrnym aktivitám a podujatiam pre cudzincov na Slovensku. Podporujeme aj charitu a z každého podujatia prispievame na humanitárne fondy. Snažíme sa ukázať silu umenie ako prostriedku na boj proti násiliu. Že každý umelec alebo fanúšik umenia vie tým odkomunikovať svoju pozíciu, prispieť k interkulturnemu dialógu a predísť aj predsudkam.Sme organizácia mladých ľudí a naši podujatia majú väčšinou komunitný aspekt, bez zvýšenej oficialnosti, a komunikácia je hravá a snažíme rozprávať voľnejším jazykom ako ste správne napísali. Táto "lekcia" by mala mať charakter rozprávania divákovi o filme a o okolitých informáciách. Chceme stále aby ťa lekcia mala prínos pre človeka ktorého zaujíma film ale aj pre obyčajného diváka. Proste nechceme robiť zo seba vedcov ale ani nechceme aby to bolo príliš zjednodušene. Hľadáme nejaký stred.Dúfam že tieto informácie vám pomôžu lepšie pochopiť o čom je náš projekt a naša organizácia celkovo :))Budget: $20Posted On: February 16, 2024 13:49 UTCCategory: Creative WritingSkills:Ukrainian, Russian, Slovak, Speech Writing, Film, Writing, Creative WritingSkills: Ukrainian, Russian, Slovak, Speech Writing, Film, Writing, Creative WritingCountry: Slovakiaclick to apply

title: Algorithm to solve a Waste Collection Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows
description: We are trying to solve a Waste Collection Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows and we hope you can help us find a solution. For the problem we have the following requirements: - All vehicles must leave and return to depot (there can be multiple depots) - All nodes must be serviced only once - The vehicle must be empty when starting a route and empty when it returns to depot - Vehicles can unload at a disposal multiple times during the route - Unloading a vehicle adds additional time to the route - All vehicles have to work in a x hours time window (depart time, unload time and return to depot time included) - Some of the nodes may have to be serviced in a specific time window (most of the time they don't have a time window) - Every node has a service time, which can be different for each node - All nodes accumulate demand except for the disposal sites and depots - All vehicles have a capacity, which can be different for each vehicle - Each vehicle must work in a distinct zone (routes should never intersect each other) We have the following data: - Nodes with longitude, latitude, service time, demand and optionally a time window - One or more depots with longitude and latitude - Disposal sites with longitude and latitude - Vehicles with capacity and time window - A distance and time matrix Our aim is to reduce as much as possibile the overall solution distance and travel time while keeping distinct zones.

title: Search algorithm development
description: We are looking for assistance in developing a search algorithm. We understand that achieving our goals will take a developer with a lot of creativity and abilities to think of things in new, different ways. This task will require real expertise. Our desire is to make life easier for academics and other researchers by creating an online ecosystem offering access to the most important people, research, institutions, funding, etc. for very narrow, specialized technological areas. In order to accomplish this goal, we need an automated search algorithm to help populate our content management system with relevant data before we invite participants to join the online community. Our search algorithm development needs are: 1. An extremely simple user interface allowing a very simple query about one focused technological niche area (such as “methane removal from ambient air” or “lithium ion battery recycling”) a. The development goal is to have one search algorithm that is flexible enough to accept any short query term 2. The algorithm will, in response to the user query: a. Scrape the Internet in order to find ~200 known information points (such as contact details, articles written, patents filed, etc.), organized by about eight categories i. We expect this scraping probably will utilize a combination of (1) iterative uses of AI sources and (2) bots to scrape specific information sources and will use a combination of paid and unpaid sources. We are open, though, to any way of accomplishing our goal. 3. Requirements document/process a. We have tried developing the search algorithm using only AI sources, but the hallucination effects of the AI sources meant that the required information quality could not be found. So, we are now looking for your help. 4. Notes: a. Query speed will not essential—it is not a problem if the search takes minutes (or even a small number of hours). Similarly, in paying for the appropriate AI sources, it will be acceptable for a search to cost several dollars or more. However, information quality will be essential—we don’t mind waiting a bit and paying a bit for quality results, but we must have quality results. b. Before you make a proposal (but after the initial inquiries), we will provide you with an outline that shows the currently required information points and that has a listing of relevant specific information sources and potential AI sources. That should be a good starting point for you to make a proposal.

title: Space Sharing Application
description: This application has the goal of simplifying the life of people sharing their home spaces with others. From tracking expenses to organizing schedules, the application will solve many issues. As this is an MVP, I would like to have it developed quickly so I can roll it out into a testing phase. If the MVP is successful, I will look to have the app built as a Native Mobile Application on both Android and iOS. There will also be addition features and functionality in the full application that aren't necessary in the MVP. Here is a basic description of each main page within the app as I envision it. The primary member will create an account on the app. He invites additional users to join his “group” within the app. The home page of the application will list any upcoming events and bills for the next 7 days. On the top left corner of each page is the navigation menu which lists the available pages. Across the top center is the name of the current page. The calendar page will offer a monthly calendar view. Each user will be able to add events to the calendar and allow them to be visible to all other members of the group. The bills page will offer a user to see the total of all bills as well as the an individual portion of the bill as it applies to each user. Bills can be split equally or each user can be assigned a specific portion (by percent) of that bill. The documents page allows a user to add their important photos and documents to applicable to them individually or everyone in the group. The chat page allows a user to chat with other users in the specific group in a group chat and individual chats. The about section offers a look into the “profile” of each person in the group. In closing, the most important features for the MVP are these: -Ability to assign different amounts (as a percent of the total bill) that each user is responsible for. -Access to a group is restricted to those that the primary user invites and accepts. -Ability to store documents and images

I am also thinking about allowing others to to use this website. So people buy 5 credits, log-in, send the auto-populated template email and the user completes the questionnaire. I've learned that the best way to do this is by fine-tuning text-davinci-003 with my data, but to be honest, I don't have much experience with coding. I'm looking for someone who can help me fine-tune the model and teach me how to prompt it to draw from the resources I've provided. Responsibilities: -Fine-tune text-davinci-003 with our gardening resources data -Optimize the model to generate text that is relevant to gardening in North Florida -Test and evaluate the performance of the model -Provide updates on the progress of the project -Teach me how to prompt through ChatGPT, so I can trigger it to draw from the data we provide Requirements: -Strong experience with Python and machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow or PyTorch -Experience fine-tuning pre-trained language models such as GPT-2 or GPT-3 -Familiarity with the openai library -Strong understanding of NLP concepts such as tokenization, embeddings, and language models -Good communication skills and patience to work with an amateur like me Beta Budget: -I'm hoping to keep my budget in the $100-$200 range for a test run with 20 pages of text. Beyond the Beta: -If the beta proves successful, I'd like to fine-tune the model with my social media tips and blogs, which I've curated into spreadsheets, easily convertible to CSV files. -Also, I need help thinking through and operationalizing how I can semi-automate or streamline the ongoing "fine-tuning" updates that will be necessary as I write additional regional-specific garden resources. I'm attaching a screenshot of one of the prompts and responses I've gotten using my text bot just for reference to see that the automation/mechanics via Zapier are already operational. But, the information it's giving is not based on my resources. That's the part I need help with.

description: Do you have experience managing direct-response marketing funnels? Are you highly organized and detail oriented? Are you a great "thought partner", who can capture my thoughts, and help brainstorm which A/B tests to run? If any of this sounds like you, then you may be a great fit for our “Marketing Optimization Manager” position. Hi, my name is Fran Rengel. And my superpower is creating high-converting video sales letters (VSL) funnels. My VSLs have generated over $50 million for my businesses over the last 10 years. Colleagues like Dan Ferrari, Justin Goff, Jon Benson, Chris Haddad and Ian Stanley consider me one of the best in the world at what I do. (If you want to see their video testimonials, check out www.BlackSwanCopy.com) I've run more tests on VSL funnels than anyone I know. And that continuous optimization process is a big part of why I've had so much success. If you're as OBSESSED with testing, and marketing funnels as I am... Then let's explore whether you'd be a great fit for our part-time "Marketing Optimization Manager" role... If chosen for this position you would be responsible for: - Organizing and revamping our split test tracking system. - Tracking our split tests, to monitor for statistical significance. - Organizing my ideas for future split tests to run on each funnel in one place. - Being a thought-partner, and assist in coming up with ideas. - Reviewing competitors’ sales funnels to and suggesting new ideas to test. - Communicate with tech team on the design of new landing pages, and ensuring they execute our vision for the landing page. - Leading a weekly (or bi-weekly) split test call where we review split tests, next tests ideas. Right now, we have 4 VSL sales funnels that are consistently getting sales. Your objective, as the Marketing Optimization Manager, is to keep these funnels in a continuous state of optimization and improvement. Chiseling away at these funnels, like Da Vinci chiseling away at a masterpiece sculpture. In just a few months, you will become an industry expert on what is converting in Video Sales Letters and be a benefactor of the knowledge we are accumulating. You will play a crucial role in the development and scaling of many “home-run” VSLs. If you consider yourself an "A-Player", and you KNOW you'd crush this opportunity after reading this then please send me a message and 1) let me know what your favorite movie is, so that I know you read this entire job listing and 2) Tell me why you’d be a good fit for this role - i.e. don’t just send me your qualifications. DISCLAIMER: Two of our marketing funnels involve men's health products about erections and sex. Some of the language in the marketing is graphic. If that is not your cup of tea, no worries - you need not apply. DISCLAIMER #2: If you consider yourself an "ideas person", and are not highly organized, you need not apply. While I am looking for a thought-partner to help me come up with new ideas, I already have wayyyy too many ideas. So the #1 thing I'm looking for is a highly organized "manager" of our funnels. I’m looking forward to chatting with you and discussing this further!

title: UI/UX Designer for mental health app
description: Objective: Design the UI/UX of an iOS app that focuses on singles and motivates them to work on themselves through mood tracking, personalized content, and goal-setting features. UI/UX Requirements: Onboarding process: a. Welcome screen with an overview of the app and its benefits. b. A series of screens to capture user preferences, including gender, age range, and interests. c. Optional screen to set initial goals or areas of self-improvement. d. A short tutorial highlighting key features and navigation tips. Home screen: a. Top section featuring the user's current mood, displayed as an emoticon or visual representation (e.g., a color-coded mood bar). b. Below the mood display, a prompt for users to update their mood and add notes. c. A personalized content feed featuring motivational quotes, articles, videos, and other resources tailored to the user's mood, preferences, and self-improvement goals. Content cards should include a title, a brief description, and an eye-catching thumbnail. d. A "Daily Challenge" card to encourage users to complete a self-improvement task, such as journaling or exercise. Navigation menu: a. A bottom navigation bar with icons for Home, Goals, Progress, and Settings. b. Home icon: Directs users to the Home screen. c. Goals icon: Directs users to the Goals screen where they can create, edit, and track personal goals. d. Progress icon: Directs users to the Progress screen, displaying mood history and goal achievements. e. Settings icon: Directs users to the Settings screen to manage preferences, notifications, and subscriptions. Goals screen: a. A list of the user's active goals, displayed as cards with a title, description, and progress bar. b. A floating action button (FAB) to create a new goal, prompting a goal creation form with fields for title, description, start date, end date, and optional milestones. c. Swipe functionality to delete, edit, or mark a goal as complete. Progress screen: a. A mood history section displaying the user's mood data over time as a line chart, with options to filter by day, week, month, or custom date range. b. A goal achievements section showcasing completed goals as a list, with options to view details, share achievements, or restart a goal. Settings screen: a. Profile management section to edit personal information, upload a profile picture, and set privacy preferences. b. Notification preferences section for users to customize the frequency and types of reminders they receive. c. Subscription management section for users to upgrade to a premium plan, view billing details, and manage payment methods. Design Specifications: Clean, modern design with easy-to-use interface Calming, neutral color palette with occasional pops of color to highlight important elements Custom illustrations and icons to create a unique and engaging user experience Consistent typography and spacing to ensure readability and visual harmony Use of subtle animations and transitions to enhance interactivity and user engagement Design should be responsive and adapt well to various screen sizes and orientations Please ensure that the final design is provided in a format compatible with iOS app development, such as Sketch or Adobe XD files, including all assets (icons, images, fonts) required for implementation.

title: 3D Printer Design
description: The project requires designing a model to host bare boards with ventilation spacing and mounting points for fans. 3D Model Design Criteria: - Stand to host 24xARM boards - Stand requires spacing between boards for ventilation and cooling requirements - Stand requires mounting points for 120mm Noctua fans - Stand must be designed to accommodate reverse positioning for input connectors S905W Board: - 120mm L x 120mm W x 15mm D (at its thickest point) Server Rack Space Dimensions: - 680mm D x 480mm W x 139.7mm H (3U) Noctua NF-P12 120mm Fan: - 120mm L x120mm W x 25mm H The design will need to take into account the board's inputs being oriented either to the left or right side of the stand. The opposite side will then be the mounting points for the 120mm fans. The stand itself should be designed so that the board can be oriented for the inputs to be placed on either side (right or left), and the mounting points for the fan as an additional attachment that can be freely attached to either side, allowing for user end capability to make that choice. The stand will need to be able to accommodate a total of 24 boards as a single print. Just as important will be the sturdiness of the board, and the holding points being as close to precise in holding the board to remain steady and in position. A sample of the board is unavailable for shipping, you will need to be able to design this 3D model without physical access to the board. The fan is generally available online. You will not be required to print a sample nor be the supplier for printing. This job is limited to just designing the model for hobbyist printing. The native 3D modeling file extension will be needed alongside an .stl format. Attached is a photo of the board and the fan, and a sample idea of a 3D stand printed from an stl freely available on the internet. This design positions the board's inputs at the top with the fan mounts at the bottom, which does not work for our design. The job will require building something of similar design but with the listed criteria. Preferred platform for communication: Discord
